entities.text: Narla Laxmana Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
The Honourable Sri Justice D.V.S.S. Somayajulu
 Criminal Petition No.6488 of 2019
Order:

This Criminal Petition is filed by the petitioner under Section 482 of the Code of Criminal Procedure to quash the proceedings against the petitioner, in FIR No.218 of 2018 on the file of Station House Officer of Chodavaram Police-Station.
The offences alleged are under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 58, 59, 26 and 30 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006.

Heard Sri R.Siva Sai Swarup, learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor appearing for the respondent-State.
Both the counsel agree that this matter is squarely covered by the judgment of the single Judge in the batch petitions bearing Criminal Petition Nos.3731 of 2018 and others.
The same was also followed in Criminal Petition No.6059 of 2019 and others by the learned single Judges of this Court.

entities.text: Criminal Petition No.6059 of 2019 and others
entities.label: CASE_NUMBER

sentences.text: In view of the fact that this matter is squarely covered by the earlier orders, the Criminal Petition is allowed and the proceedings against the petitioner in FIR No.218 of 2018, on the file of Station House Officer of Chodavaram Police-Station for the offences under Sections 188, 272, 273, 328 of Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Sections 58, 59, 26 and 30 of the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, are hereby quashed.
As a sequel, miscellaneous petitions, if any, pending in this criminal petition shall stand closed.

D.V.S.S. SOMAYAJULU, J Date: 11.11.2019 B/o GR Narla Laxmana Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 11 November, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/143004659/
